page_title: NEW 1-1 EVE | Newcastle v Everton 02/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Dwight McNeil (Everton) for his blatant foul.
90+8' Chermiti (Everton) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+5' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+3' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+2' Andre Gomes (Everton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' It is time for a substitution. Seamus Coleman (Everton) is on for Ben Godfrey.
88' 1 - 1 Goal! Martin Dubravka gets a hand on the penalty from Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
88' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is going to take the penalty!
86' The Everton players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
85' There's a break in play and referee Tony Harrington must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Everton using VAR. This could be interesting!

84' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
84' PENALTY APPEAL after Ashley Young (Everton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
84' Dwight McNeil (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Chermiti (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Idrissa Gueye.
81' James Tarkowski (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
79' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Lewis Hall is replaced by Paul Dummett (Newcastle Utd).
76' The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
75' Jordan Pickford pulls off a great save to deny Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
73' Everton concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) will replace Elliot Anderson.
70' Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
68' A pass lands at the feet of Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
66' What a sweet volley by James Garner (Everton)! Despite the effort his shot only rattles the crossbar.
64' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
61' Here is a change. Beto is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Amadou Onana will be replaced by James Garner (Everton).
60' Substitution. Andre Gomes (Everton) in, Abdoulaye Doucoure out.
60' The goal by Newcastle won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
59' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Newcastle players aren’t happy.
58' Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Alexander Isak finds Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
57' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Tony Harrington blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
55' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Beto (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
53' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
53' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
50' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
48' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Referee Tony Harrington blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The referee awards a corner and Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take it.

45+3' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) cracked a first-time shot, but the goalkeeper pulled off an amazing save.

43' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Martin Dubravka shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
41' Beto (Everton) brings an opponent down and Tony Harrington interrupts the game.
40' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' The game is interrupted now, Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
35' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
35' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Newcastle will take a corner kick.
31' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Great individual play by Beto (Everton) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
28' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
25' Amadou Onana (Everton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tony Harrington blows for a foul.
23' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
20' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Amadou Onana (Everton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Newcastle have a free kick.
18' Tony Harrington interrupts the game. One of the players from Newcastle won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
18' Neat passing move from Newcastle in order to create new attacking opportunities. The possession of the ball – 63:37.
15' 1 - 0 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Jordan Pickford with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the corner kick.
14' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' Newcastle can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Newcastle force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' James Tarkowski (Everton) latches onto the free kick from Dwight McNeil, but heads just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
8' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes a direct free kick.
7' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Everton are awarded a free kick.

7' CHANCE! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Dwight McNeil. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
5' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and it's Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

2' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Everton will kick the game off.
Tony Harrington got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
